Subject: Physics
Type: integerQuestion (numerical answer)

Question:
The volume contraction of a solid copper cube of edge length 10 cm, when subjected to a hydraulic pressure of 7×10^6 Pa , would be ____ mm^3 .
(Given bulk modulus of copper =1.4×10^11Nm^(−2) )

text:
```json
{
 "answer": "50",
 "value": "50 mm^3",
 "working": "Bulk modulus B = P / (ΔV / V) => ΔV = (P * V) / B.\nGiven L = 0.1 m, V = 10^-3 m^3 = 10^6 mm^3.\nΔV = (7 × 10^6 Pa * 10^6 mm^3) / (1.4 × 10^11 Pa) = 50 mm^3.",
 "confidence": 1.0,
 "issues": []
}
```
code:
L = 0.1  # m
V = L**3  # m^3
P = 7e6  # Pa
B = 1.4e11  # N/m^2

delta_V_m3 = (P * V) / B
delta_V_mm3 = delta_V_m3 * 1e9  # convert m^3 to mm^3

print(f"delta_V in m^3: {delta_V_m3}")
print(f"delta_V in mm^3: {delta_V_mm3}")
